title: Approval Record
description: Machine-verifiable client approval bound to a specific task, PR and commit SHA. A plain Discord message is NOT an approval record.

commit_sha.description: The exact commit SHA the client reviewed and approved

qa_status.description: QA status at time of approval

qa_commit_sha.description: Commit SHA the QA report covered

client_id.description: Authenticated client identity — not a Discord display name

approval_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the authenticated approval

notes.description: Optional client notes or rejection reasons
